requirements: All definition documents validate against their declared schemas and cross-references.
Every required applicable case/device/provider tuple has current passed evidence.
Every referenced performance gate has a conforming measurement.
Every non-waivable invariant is evaluated and passed.
Every required approval is approved, unexpired, and references the exact definition/evidence aggregate hashes.
No campaign identity field is absent, placeholder, or fabricated.
No evidence or attachment violates privacy-safe diagnostics rules.

statusRules.passed: All requirements are true and no required tuple is failed, blocked, notRun, or unauthorized notApplicable.
statusRules.failed: Any executed required case, numerical gate, or non-waivable invariant fails.
statusRules.blocked: Execution cannot proceed because required hardware, provider, permission, model, account, or approval is unavailable.
statusRules.incomplete: Required evidence or campaign identity is missing, stale, notRun, or awaiting review.
